summary: Join our Pension Plan Reporting and Disclosure Requirements training course to gain vital knowledge and ensure your organization meets all regulatory standards.
lede: Pension plan reporting and disclosure involves checking pension data and presenting it clearly in financial statements and communications. For HR, finance, compliance, pension administration and governance professionals, the course supports preparing and reviewing pension information. Participants learn to validate data, interpret actuarial summaries, connect valuations with accounting entries, and produce clear disclosures and member communications.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly prepare, review, or rely on pension plan reports and disclosures.
audience: Pension fund administrators and scheme managers
modules: Foundations of Pension Plans and Regulatory Frameworks
Understanding Pension Data, Assumptions, and Valuations
Disclosure Requirements for Pension Plans and Sponsors
Working with Actuaries, Administrators, and Auditors
Governance, Risk, and Compliance in Pension Reporting
Regulatory Reviews, Inspections, and Enforcement Risks
Common Pitfalls and Improvement Opportunities in Pension Reporting
Building a Practical Pension Reporting and Disclosure Toolkit
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial statements and pension plan operations. Experience in HR, finance, or compliance roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
